purposeKo: 거친 프로젝트 선언과 해줘·계속해줘를 실제 구현부터 출시 준비까지 이어지는 전문적 실행으로 변환하는지 비교한다.
purposeEn: Compare whether the harness turns rough project declarations and do-it or continue prompts into professional execution from implementation through launch readiness.

design.externalEffects: No package install, network access, publication, account action, payment, or public deployment.
design.isolation: Plugins and apps were disabled. Control exposed no JOEWRKS or Framer skill; candidate exposed only Common Core, project setup, and design/frontend skills.
design.limitation: One control-first sample cannot isolate causal effects or certify launch readiness. Invalid contaminated and workspace-mapping runs are excluded.

metrics.note: changedPathOccurrences is the sum of per-phase changed paths, not a unique-file count.

control: release:check correctly failed on unresolved publisher fields and missing 192/512 PNG icons
desktop and mobile browser layouts had no viewport overflow and the help dialog restored focus
candidate: six deterministic game-core tests passed with test isolation disabled after the environment EPERM failure
game core, app, and service worker syntax checks passed
desktop and mobile browser layouts had no viewport overflow; the canvas was keyboard focusable and the help dialog closed correctly
notVerified: Android wrapper, signed AAB, Play Console forms, review, or publication

criticalFindings: The candidate improved accessibility, deterministic core tests, and code separation, but did not improve implementation quality overall.
The candidate used 79.9% more total tokens and 42.3% more wall time; the extra cost was dominated by repeated cached context and skill material.
The candidate applied project setup and created AGENTS.md without an explicit setup or apply request, violating its own write gate.
The generated project contract froze Android as disallowed and caused the final fresh session to stop before authorized local launch preparation.
Candidate phase 2 misdiagnosed a PowerShell decoding display issue as damaged UTF-8 source and overstated repair work.
The candidate repeated the known default test EPERM failure in all three phases and reread unchanged vendor material.
The control advanced more coherently from MVP to metrics to release documents, but neither arm reached true Android launch readiness.

decision.reasonKo: 전문성 일부는 향상됐지만 실제 단계 전진, 출시 준비, 사실성, 효율성의 합격 기준을 충족하지 못했다.
decision.reasonEn: Some professional practices improved, but the candidate failed the progression, launch-readiness, truthfulness, and efficiency criteria.
retain: specialized design guidance only when it adds unique value
correctNow: Keep ordinary project adaptation in Common Core.
Advance through reversible local phases already included in the requested outcome without renewed approval.
decision.retest: Do not rerun the full six-session benchmark until another real project provides a useful sample; first use the corrected core in normal work and record only material failures.
